summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of Warung Sayur KenKai MVP. Backend (pytest, 8/8 passed) and Frontend (Playwright end-to-end catalog -> cart -> checkout -> WhatsApp) both fully working. Critical requirement — satuan preservation across product/cart/checkout/WhatsApp message and required WA line format ('Jumlah: <qty> <satuan>', 'Harga: Rp.. / <satuan>', 'Subtotal: ..') — verified passing for multiple satuan types (ikat, kg). Order number format KKN-YYYYMMDD-XXX correctly generated and increments on each call. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Products without foto (Gula Pasir 013, Minyak Goreng 012) fall back to the built-in SVG placeholder — cosmetic only, PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE fallback works as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses `os.environ['MONGO_URL']` and `os.environ['DB_NAME']` at import time — will crash on missing env, which is desired fail-fast behavior. OK.
product_service.py: in-memory cache is not thread-safe but acceptable for FastAPI single-process serving. Cache uses TTL properly.
Checkout.jsx: build+redirect to wa.me is fully client-side; cart cleared after 800ms nav. Order number generated only after form validation — good.
format.js: buildWhatsAppMessage always emits `Jumlah: <qty> <satuan>` and `Harga: Rp.. / <satuan>` per item. Forbidden '<qty> x Rp..' format is NOT emitted.
Products.jsx: category/availability/sort/search all client-side with proper useMemo — fine for ~13-item catalog. If catalog grows large consider server-side filtering.

Owner WA number is placeholder '62XXXXXXXXXXX' — will produce invalid wa.me link once real deployment happens. Deployment step must set OWNER_WHATSAPP_NUMBER env var (already parameterised via os.environ.get — good).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None. Mock catalog is bundled inside product_service.MOCK_CSV (13 active + 1 inactive product 014).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/config, /api/products (13 active, excludes inactive 014, includes stok=0 product 012), /api/categories (7 categories, excludes 'Lainnya' from 014), /api/products/{id} (404 on unknown and on inactive 014), POST /api/order-number (format KKN-YYYYMMDD-XXX + daily seq increments). Frontend flows tested: search by nama, category chip filter (Buah=1), availability filter (tersedia=12, habis=1), sorting (harga-asc first=008 Telur, nama A-Z first=005 Apel Fuji), Habis badge + disabled add on 012, product detail modal +/- and add, add-from-card + header cart badge, cart page satuan-aware qty ('2 ikat'), +/- and cart-total updates, empty-cart with start-shopping link, checkout validation errors, method toggle diantar/ambil (pickup-info shown for ambil, alamat hidden), form submission intercepted window.open — captured wa.me URL and decoded body: contains all required lines including 'Jumlah: 2 ikat', 'Harga: Rp5.000 / ikat', 'Subtotal: Rp10.000', 'Jumlah: 1 kg', 'Harga: Rp12.000 / kg', 'Total: Rp22.000', 'Metode:\nDiantar', 'KKN-YYYYMMDD-XXX' order number, and NO forbidden 'N x Rp..' format. Post-submit cart cleared and redirected to /. There are 2 window.open calls (index 0 is empty from a chat-widget bootstrap, index 1 is the actual wa.me link); test must filter by url contains 'wa.me'.
